title: Khronos Sponsors Open-Source glTF Importer/Exporter for Autodesk 3ds Max
subtitle: The Khronos Group has sponsored the glTF 2.0 Importer/Exporter for Autodesk 3ds Max open-source project under the Apache 2.0 license, and today has released the resulting glTF importer and exporter plugins, built to professional standards in collaboration with the community, and free for all to use.
